properties.description: A `--shared` client tells the server the working tree it runs in: the proxy knows its own cwd, so it sends the tree root and the checked-out branch at initialize, and a session may also declare them explicitly. The server records them against the session's seat, measures that session's registered files under THAT root, and routes its branch-scoped writes to its branch's overlay. A session that declares nothing, or sits on the default branch, behaves as today. Builds on chg:a-shared-client-outside-the-project-attaches-to-the-running-server, which made cross-folder attachment reliable. Designed 2026-09-23.
properties.name: A session is known by its worktree and branch
